question: Square \(ABCD\) has side length 4. Draw arc \(BD\) with center \(A\) and radius 4. The area of the circular segment enclosed by arc \(BD\) and chord \(BD\) is
solution: Area of the circular segment = area of sector \(ABD\) − area of \(\triangle ABD\) \(=90\pi\times 16/360-4\times 4/2=4\pi-8\).
